title: Benjamín Zúñiga Silva
text:
Email · CV · GitHub


ENES


I am a political scientist working on comparative politics in Latin America. My research examines state–citizen relations, state capacity, and democratic erosion, with a particular interest in how political authority is exercised where the state is weak or contested.
I am currently pursuing an M.A. in Political Science (Government and Public Policy) at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, and I have been admitted to the M.A. in Political Science at McGill University. I hold a B.A. in Political Science from the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, where I wrote my thesis on anthropogenic climate change and political legitimacy under the supervision of Ross Mittiga.
I have worked as a research assistant at the Millennium Institute VIODEMOS, the Millennium Nucleus ICLAC, and COES, building original comparative and georeferenced datasets in R. I have also worked as a teaching assistant at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile and the Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez.

Interests
State capacity · Democratic erosion · Citizenship and violence · Latin American politics · Democratic theory

Soy cientista político, y me especializo en política comparada en América Latina. Mi investigación se enfoca en las relaciones entre Estado y ciudadanía, la capacidad estatal y la erosión democrática, con especial interés en cómo se ejerce la autoridad política donde la presencia del Estado es débil o disputada.
Actualmente curso el Magíster en Ciencia Política, mención Gobierno y Políticas Públicas, en la Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, y fui admitido al M.A. in Political Science de McGill University. Soy Cientista Político de la Pontificia Universidad Católica de Chile, donde escribí mi tesis sobre cambio climático antropogénico y legitimidad política bajo la supervisión de Ross Mittiga.
He trabajado como ayudante de investigación en el Instituto Milenio VIODEMOS, el Núcleo Milenio ICLAC y COES, construyendo bases de datos comparadas y georreferenciadas originales en R. También he sido ayudante de cátedra en la PUC y en la Universidad Adolfo Ibáñez.

Intereses
Capacidad estatal · Erosión democrática · Ciudadanía y violencia · Política latinoamericana · Teoría democrática

title: Research
text:
Research experience

Populism in Chile and Uruguay
Research Assistant to Juan Pablo Luna, 2026–present.
Review and editing of a book manuscript on populism in Chile and Uruguay.


Citizenship and violence in Latin America
Millennium Institute VIODEMOS, with Juan Pablo Luna, 2024–2025.
An original comparative dataset linking citizenship rights with criminal, structural, and political violence, integrating V-Dem, LAPOP, Latinobarómetro, and original coding. Statistical analyses of state weakness, citizenship gaps, and impunity, and contributions to a FONDECYT proposal on crises of representation and party system change.


Crime exposure and educational performance
COES, with Alejandra Abufhele, Naim Bro, and Juan Pablo Luna, 2024–2025.
A georeferenced dataset linking criminal events to educational outcomes in Santiago, analyzed with fixed-effects models and geospatial methods.


Chinese foreign direct investment in Latin America
Millennium Nucleus ICLAC, 2024–2025.
Project manager of an interactive public data platform on foreign direct investment, leading an international team of eight researchers and expanding coverage from 7 to 12 countries.


Governance of extractive investment in Africa and Latin America
Millennium Nucleus ICLAC, with María Montt, 2023–2024.
Comparative study of extractive investment governance, with statistical analysis of economic and institutional indicators.


Chinese COVID-19 aid to Latin America
FONDECYT project “Chinese Business and Structural Power,” with Francisco Urdinez, 2022.
A dataset on Chinese COVID-19 aid donations to Latin America, mapping patterns across countries and administrative levels.
